we have developed a novel genetic marking system that allows cells to permanently express a marker of their choice in response to mild warming in vivo.

the development of new technologies for the study of metastasis, with the aim of identifying novel therapeutic targets for this disease.
the development and application of novel technologies that allow tracking of metastasising cancer cells in vivo.
